newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices rise, volume down.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange fell back to lower levels in subdued trade on Wednesday, after temporarily jumping on Tuesday amid physical demand, while prices rose in line with world trends.
Volume slipped to 270 kilos on weak free market demand, after 680 kilos on Tuesday and 125 kilos on Monday.
Gold closed at $370.60 an ounce against Tuesday's $369.30 and at 1,234,000 lira per gram versus 1,230,000.
The lira which weakened to 103,480 to the dollar from Tuesday's 103,360 close also helped the rise in lira gold prices.
Dealers said the outlook remained uncertain despite the firming of world prices. With a lack of physical demand from the free market, traders preferred to wait and see, they added.
All of the day's trading occurred in the morning session, with 77.8 percent of total trade conducted in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
